correctness.rationale: Direct algebra reduces Eqs. (15)–(16) to \(h(x_i)=L(S)\); the derivative of \(h\) has a unique interior minimum when v>1, giving the exact cubic exclusion boundary for \(u<1\). For \(u\ge1\), strict convexity of \(Q=(1-z)^{-1}-u-vz\) makes the positive-pressure branch unique; zero-pressure and all square boundary states are treated explicitly. Choosing a positive two-preimage level constructs all strictly supercritical (\(u,v\)) attainable cases within valid original parameter ranges. The exact rational witness and 324 arithmetic identities were independently checked; the all-parameter claim relies on the provided proof.

value.rationale: The source asks which structural parameters allow two otherwise symmetric communities to sustain different mean stationary opinions, and computes regimes numerically. The new result supplies a sharp uniform analytic obstruction over a natural infinite parameter family, with a constructive converse and exact equality boundary. It explains the source’s strong dependence on triangle assortativity while distinguishing any stationary asymmetry from stable disparity. This is a motivated structural theorem, not a renamed scalar exercise or arbitrary isolated numerical slice.
